index.html.title: Seymour Maison T-Shirts | Collection, Fit & Availability
index.html.description: Explore Seymour Maison’s T-shirt collection and brand information. Review fit questions, contact the maison and request current availability by email.
index.html.heading: Compare the collection, fit and availability
index.html.body:
Explore the T-shirt collection and the lookbook, then review frequently asked questions before deciding what to request. Confirm the garment’s measurements, fabric, care and current availability directly with the maison.

Ask a product or fit question, or request availability by email. Email requests are sent through your email app; they are not an order or a reservation of a particular size.
